datasets.name: Global Landslide Dataset for Change Detection (GLaD4CD)
datasets.verbatim: The final dataset, which includes 174 bi-temporal Sentinel-2 images, was then used for further analysis. It has been published and is freely available on Zenodo (https://zenodo.org/records/14226448).

datasets.name: Sentinel-2 Level-1C (S2L1C) products
datasets.verbatim: The imagery retrieved consists of Sentinel-2 Level-1C (S2L1C) products, providing orthorectified Top-Of-Atmosphere reflectance across all 13 spectral bands.

datasets.name: SSL4EO-S12 dataset
datasets.verbatim: The SSL4EO project (Wang et al. 2023) introduced a large-scale, multi-modal dataset designed to pre-train geospatial foundation models... The dataset, models, and source code are publicly available on GitHub.12... 12. https://github.com/zhu-xlab/SSL4EO-S12

methods.name: LandslideMetric-CD
methods.summary: An unsupervised change detection model adapted from Metric-CD, which integrates the SSL4EO DINO geospatial foundation model as a feature extractor to process multi-temporal Sentinel-2 imagery and generate landslide probability maps.
methods.source: Authors' own development (based on Bandara and Patel 2023)
methods.verbatim: The authors published the implementation of the model in a GitHub repository,11 which was used in our study to adapt the original implementation to our use case... 11. https://github.com/wgcban/Metric-CD

availability.author_statement: Data availability statement present with shared links.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory (GLaD4CD) and other input datasets are linked and publicly available. The custom code for the LandslideMetric-CD method is given through a repository.
